test_inputs.explanation: The only concrete value visible from the agent's execution is the final navigation URL: 'http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/sales_order/view/order_id/306/'. That URL contains an internal order_id (306) used to open the order detail page, but the tool schema only supports searching/filtering the sales order grid, not direct navigation by order_id. No query parameters, form inputs, or dropdown selections are exposed in the summary (all actions are 'unknown'), so we cannot reliably infer values for increment_id, status, dates, totals, or names. To keep the replay safe and consistent, we assume a fresh search with filters reset and on the first page of results. Hence only 'reset_before': true and 'page_number': 1 are provided, and all other optional parameters are omitted because there is no evidence of their actual values in the execution trace.
